messages: 14 of 16 functions could move to standard features or configuration; 1 stay custom, 1 can be retired.
Integrations stay custom: TradePromotionService. They can still be simplified (named credential, retries through a queue or platform event).
4 quick wins with low effort and contained regression: blocks the save when a field rule fails; builds and sends an email in code; sets the status automatically.
Order of execution matters in 2 places: Shelf Check → Store Visit, Opportunity → Subscription. Steps that depend on each other move together.
Sequence-sensitive inside Trade Promotion triggers and handlers: later steps use results of earlier ones in the same save.
Structural risks: business thresholds held in code; logic keyed on text values; errors hidden from users.

quickWins.what: Blocks the save when a field rule fails
Builds and sends an email in code
quickWins.replaceWith: Email template with an email alert, sent from a flow or an approval step.
Approval process entry criteria or a before-save flow; keep any threshold as custom metadata, not in code.

quickWins.what: Whole class: no live code calls it
quickWins.replaceWith: Not called by any active trigger or class and not an entry point (screen, flow, batch, schedule or API). Remove it with its test after confirming in the org.

crossCutting.title: Business thresholds held in code
crossCutting.detail: A limit the business owns is changed only by a developer and a release; custom metadata keeps it as configuration.

crossCutting.title: Logic keyed on text values
crossCutting.detail: Decisions taken on a user, profile or record name break when a label changes; a custom permission or a setting is safer.

crossCutting.title: Errors hidden from users
crossCutting.detail: A catch block only logs the error, so failures are silent.

crossCutting.title: Dead code that looks live
crossCutting.detail: Code no live trigger or class calls is still deployed; readers and tools can mistake it for live logic.

crossCutting.title: Test-only code in production
crossCutting.detail: Test.isRunningTest() changes behaviour under test, so tests do not prove what runs in production.

crossCutting.title: Hard-coded ID prefixes
crossCutting.detail: Checks like '005' to tell users from queues; use the Schema describe or instanceof instead.

chains.text: Saving Shelf Check updates Store Visit (keeps totals on store visit from its related records), which fires StoreVisitTrigger. Move these steps together, or keep them together.
Saving Opportunity updates Subscription (creates subscription records automatically), which fires SubscriptionTrigger. Move these steps together, or keep them together.
